audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text called her passive 'Passive Incinerate stun'. Incinerate is her W; the stun is Pyromania.
audit.why: Riot: Pyromania — after casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell stuns, and she starts the game and each respawn with it available. That last clause matters: she is stunned-up at level 1 and after every death.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now names Pyromania and the four-cast requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text treated Tibbers as the threat clock; the real clock is how fast Pyromania restacks.
audit.why: Disintegrate is 4s and Incinerate 7s, so she restacks the stun simply by farming the wave. Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100s at only 600 range, so she has to be inside your Q range to use it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around the restack rate and Tibbers' range.

audit.why: LeBlanc spikes at 2, 6 (Mimic 45/35/25s), first item; Annie at 6 and again on full build where a stacked stun into Tibbers is a one-shot.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Molten Shield absorbing the burst window.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags shield-absorbs-burst: E is a 10s, 800-range shield that also damages anyone who strikes her with attacks or spells, so it both eats the sigil detonation and punishes the auto.
audit.corrected: Stated in dontsFull[2].d and in the 2+ items row.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[N] read LeBlanc x6 then Annie.
audit.why: packet.levelChart agrees with the content layer; the full layer is the outlier and phases[6].why described LeBlanc winning a row the other layer gives to Annie.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned as one atomic group; phases[6].why rewritten to the Annie verdict.
